objective: Is a TRAINABLE tokenless native role-aligned factual relation key/value readout able to approximate public causal-rule identification from 16 actual action-consequence observations, including on completely new Boolean laws, better than same-capacity lost feedback, lost roles, scrambled outcome controls, scratch R103 native scalar, fully trained conventional GRU and MLP, and a strong hand-engineered 256-function Bayesian comparison?

hypothesis.mechanism: Role-aligned public factor binding plus learned smooth relation-key readout will use actual factual consequences to transfer to new 3-operand causal operators without private rule truth or rule id.
hypothesis.value: Native role-aligned learner will surpass fully trained strongest conventional baseline and scratch R103 native on heldout rule action accuracy with matched training steps and public source.
hypothesis.falsification: Failure to beat negative controls or conventional baselines means the mechanism is insufficient even if Bayes inference identifies the truth; preserve failure and do not retroactively lower thresholds.

data.support_action_schedule: Eight CALIBRATE and eight EXPLOIT_POS chosen factual interventions alternating; shared across every learning arm.
data.query: A fresh physical query world after 16 supports, with actual chosen action consequence alone as FIT/VALID regression target; paired actions+returns only in UNIT_ONLY_UNSEEN evaluator.
data.physical_source: R85 pure physical simulator/R86 actual action returns with fresh R105 RNGs; public role tags + noisy factor readings in R88 public slots; no prior original source or weights.
data.family_allocation: TRAIN index % 11 -> familiar; HELDOUT index % 8 -> unfamiliar, 16 episodes per heldout rule; public pivot parity via floor(index / number_of_families) % 2, balanced within each hidden family.

architecture.native_role_binding: Trainable differentiable 3-role key embedding from PUBLIC noisy factor observations and public role-index tags. Uses smooth role binding to three operand slots; query-conditioned memory read over 16 factual supports. No symbolic Boolean operator label, truth table, engineered parity, or future outcome in native model.
architecture.memory: Within-episode learned support-to-query similarity with outcome-conditioned values, no autoregressive next-token or Transformer foundation, no retained source outside episode.
architecture.explicit_decision_readout: Trainable action-value readout on physical public query action and factual memory, learned solely through chosen-action reward regression.
architecture.model_init: Fresh deterministic seed per arm, no R103 trained checkpoints. Scratch R103 native model used as a baseline, not donor weights.
architecture.all_models_public_information: All trainable models see exactly same 16 support public slots, actual chosen outcomes and query public slots unless explicitly ablated.
architecture.Bayes256: R104 hand-engineered full-256-function posterior is an evidence-sufficiency upper comparator only, not a learned native arm, and sees the same public 16 factual supports/roles.
negative_controls: native reward shuffled within chosen action

evaluation.threshold_policy: All checks required in ALL THREE UNIT_ONLY seeds for DEV signal only.
